label: GO step late in the episode (trials 90-99) after a rare-rewarded a1->S2 trial
explanation: Fires only at GO, only when the previous trial was rewarded (in_rew=0 at GO, but prev_reward=1 in every activation), and almost only in the last ~10 trials of the episode (98% of mass at ep_trial 90-99; equivalently, value-head output in its lowest bin <5.2). The strongest activations (top quartile) are GO steps right after a1 led rarely to S2 and was rewarded, where the agent then switches to a2 (the model-based response): this clause has dev precision 0.88, recall 0.56, mass recall 0.72. The remaining ~28% of mass is weaker firing at late-episode GO after a common a2->S2 rewarded trial (prev_state S2 rewarded generally), but that case has low precision (adding it gives P 0.15 / R 0.86), so it was left out. Never fires at D1 or D2, after unrewarded trials, or before trial ~85. All variables used are observed (previous trial history and episode time, which the agent can track via its value estimate); no future variables.
